features.description: RenderedEvent contract + token-only command validator + translation disposition table. Define a typed RenderedEvent dataclass whose fields map cleanly onto ActionItem (band, title, detail, exact_command, evidence_uri) plus a headline-only derived accessor for terminal-notifier. Implement a side-effect-free command-shape validator (Approach 2 per D012) in a new scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/command_validation.py module. Produce a translation disposition table covering all 27 INBOX event kinds from the F001 inventory at evidence/f001-inventory-draft.md with explicit (live | dashboard_action | inbox_only | audit_only) verdict per kind. Validator is token-only and never invokes _<cmd>_main(...) handlers per D021; vocabulary drift mitigation is manual PR discipline (validator vocabulary updates land in the same PR as subcommand changes). No copy text is committed yet; this feature ships the contracts that F003 will populate.
steps: Add scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/event_copy.py module with the RenderedEvent dataclass (frozen, fields: band, title, detail, exact_command, evidence_uri, disposition, technical_metadata) plus headline accessor. Mirror operator_console.ActionItem field semantics; do not duplicate the ActionItem class itself.

Add scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/command_validation.py with validate_command_tokens(tokens: list[str]) -> ValidationResult. Enumerate the subcommand vocabulary by reading the dispatch ladder in cli.py:3105-3175; per-subcommand expected-arg-count + flag-prefix map. Never invoke any subcommand handler. Per D021, do NOT round-trip validate by calling _<cmd>_main(argv) — those functions parse and execute together. Vocabulary drift mitigation is manual: validator updates land in the same PR as new subcommands or flags.

Add a translation-disposition data table (Python dict keyed by INBOX event_name string per D017) committing every one of the 27 kinds enumerated in evidence/f001-inventory-draft.md Section 2 to exactly one of {live, dashboard_action, inbox_only, audit_only}. Disposition is data; rendering logic stays in F003.

Add a deliberately-wrong-command fixture: assert validate_command_tokens(["approve", "--badflag"]) fails, validate_command_tokens(["approve", "<plan>", "<gate>"]) passes, etc. Per D008 the F003 renderer must consult this validator before populating exact_command.

Add tests covering: RenderedEvent frozen invariant, disposition-table totality (all 27 kinds present, no duplicates), validator rejects malformed shapes, validator-vocabulary purity (no subprocess calls, no module imports beyond stdlib + project local data).
features.acceptance: (1) scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/event_copy.py exists with RenderedEvent dataclass; fields match the ActionItem subset documented in D002+D003. (2) scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/command_validation.py exposes validate_command_tokens(...) with token-only validation; never invokes subcommand handlers; no _<cmd>_main round-trip per D021. (3) Translation disposition table covers all 27 INBOX event kinds with explicit verdict per kind; totality enforced by test. (4) Deliberately-wrong-command fixture passes (validator catches bad shapes). (5) Validator-purity test confirms no subprocess, no handler invocation, no side effects. (6) Tests pass; sanitization clean.

features.description: NotifyEvent metadata extension + inbox_event translation key + technical_metadata bag + action_link aliasing + six new emit sites for currently-silent high-value events. All optional/defaulted; existing emit sites continue to work without populating new fields. Alias action_link to evidence_uri per D005. Add NotifyEvent dispatch at six currently-silent emit sites: verdict_mismatch, no_progress_classification, environmental_blocker_short_circuit, verdict_blocked_reconciled, gate_state_reconciliation_failed, architecture_regen_failed. INBOX writes precede every new dispatch (existing invariant preserved). Compute feature_display_name at each emit site where loaded.feature(feature_id) is in scope per D006.

features.description: event_copy module + translation table + per-sink renderers + sidecar pattern. Implement scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/event_copy.render(event, plan_meta, feature_meta) -> RenderedEvent. Translation table keyed by NotifyEvent.inbox_event (the INBOX event= value, per D017) which matches the F001 disposition table; references value-first vocabulary from docs/design/dashboard-value-language-ia-v0/copy-map.md. Per D008: where no canonical CLI exists (gate_state_reconciliation_failed, verdict_mismatch, generic error), render exact_command=None with explanation-only copy; the F001 command-validator enforces this. Per D009: breaker:patch_incomplete renders by normalizing internally to event=breaker_tripped + breaker_kind=patch_incomplete; INBOX event name unchanged. Per D010: brand-drift translation happens at render boundary; jarvis approve / jarvis-orchestrate approve / Jarvis [...] in source body strings are normalized to dontpanic equivalents in rendered output; source body strings are NOT edited. Per D013 + D018: inbox.py adds an additive append_rendered_annotation() wrapper that appends ONLY the rendered markdown block (with <details> for technical metadata); existing append_event() calls at emit sites are unchanged and continue to write the raw entry first. Update sinks: notify_discord.py emits rich embed (sink upgrade — color from copy map's 4-band taxonomy as inline hex literals per D022, payload-limit aware); notify.py terminal-notifier consumes RenderedEvent.headline and fixes Jarvis [{plan_id}] title to DontPanic [{plan_id}]; operator_console.py adds a write_event_action_sidecar() writer that appends ActionItems to ~/.dontpanic/dashboard/event-actions.jsonl. Per D003 + D019: sidecar merge happens at BOTH dashboard.build() (before render_json writes out_dir/what-now.json) AND operator_console.write_cache() via a shared merge_with_event_sidecar() helper. Do NOT push directly into what-now.json from dispatch_event; the merge happens at dashboard build/cache time only.
steps: Implement event_copy.render(event, plan_meta, feature_meta) -> RenderedEvent. Translation table is a Python dict keyed by NotifyEvent.inbox_event (per D017, the INBOX event= value at the paired append_event call); each entry has headline_template, why_template, action_template (or None per D008), and inherits disposition from the F001 table.

Translation table copy references docs/design/dashboard-value-language-ia-v0/copy-map.md vocabulary: Approval needed (gate_hit), Blocked work (volley_terminal non-signed-off, error), Setup drift (reconcile-derived), Active AI work (volley_start), System warning (architecture_regen_failed, gate_state_reconciliation_failed), AI work finished (signoff), etc. Do not author new vocabulary.

Per D008 honest-commands rule: gate_state_reconciliation_failed, verdict_mismatch, generic error → exact_command=None with explanation-only why text. Renderer asserts validate_command_tokens() passes for any non-None exact_command before returning the RenderedEvent.

Per D009 backward-compat: breaker:patch_incomplete event renders by normalizing internally to event=breaker_tripped + breaker_kind=patch_incomplete. INBOX event name unchanged; structured rendering uses normalized form.

Per D010 brand-drift translation: implement a renderer-side normalizer that replaces all 'jarvis approve' → 'dontpanic approve', 'jarvis-orchestrate approve' → 'dontpanic approve', 'Jarvis [' → 'DontPanic [' in rendered output. Do NOT modify source body strings in supervisor.py.

Update scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/notify_discord.py: consume RenderedEvent, emit rich Discord embed instead of single content string. Embed color from the 4-band taxonomy as inline hex literals per D022 (healthy=0x3DD68C, action=0xF5A623, blocked=0xF25555, pending=0x7E8BA6) — sourced from docs/design/dashboard-value-language-ia-v0/copy-map.md band tokens, NOT from a dp-tokens.css file (no such asset exists in this repo). Title=RenderedEvent.title, description=RenderedEvent.detail, exact_command as a labeled field, evidence_uri in footer. Respect Discord 2000-char payload limit (truncate body, never truncate exact_command).

Per D013 + D018 INBOX additive wrapper: add scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/inbox.append_rendered_annotation(plan_dir, *, plan_id, rendered, timestamp=None) that appends ONLY a rendered markdown block (with <details>Technical details</details> fold) to INBOX.md. Existing emit sites continue to call append_event() directly for the raw truth-of-record entry; the dispatch flow additionally calls append_rendered_annotation() after dispatch_event for live and dashboard_action dispositions. inbox.append_event() signature unchanged; no double raw-entry write.

Update scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/notify.py: consume RenderedEvent. Title goes from 'Jarvis [{plan_id}]' to 'DontPanic [{plan_id}]' (terminal brand fix). Subtitle stays as event.kind; message body becomes RenderedEvent.headline (not first 140 chars of body markdown).

Per D003 sidecar pattern: add scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/operator_console.write_event_action_sidecar(rendered, source) that appends an ActionItem-shaped entry to ~/.dontpanic/dashboard/event-actions.jsonl. Sidecar file is per-line JSON for append-safety; one ActionItem per line.

Per D003 + D019 sidecar merge: add a shared scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/operator_console.merge_with_event_sidecar(provider_items: list[ActionItem]) -> list[ActionItem] helper that reads event-actions.jsonl and merges into the provider-derived list. Dedupe by ActionItem.id; provider-derived items win conflicts (event sidecar is advisory). Call merge_with_event_sidecar() from BOTH (a) dashboard.build() before render_json writes out_dir/what-now.json (see scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/dashboard.py:310), AND (b) operator_console.write_cache() (~line 665-687) before writing the dashboard home cache. Both write paths must merge or the served dashboard state goes stale.

Wire dispatch_event flow: render() is called when event_copy disposition is live or dashboard_action; output is fed to the relevant sinks per disposition (live → Discord + terminal + sidecar + INBOX annotation; dashboard_action → sidecar + INBOX annotation only; inbox_only and audit_only → no rendering, raw INBOX entry from existing append_event() only).

Add tests covering: translation table covers every kind with a defined disposition (via D017 inbox_event key); live kinds render to Discord + terminal-notifier; dashboard_action kinds render to sidecar only; brand-drift normalization fires on all rendered output; breaker:patch_incomplete normalizes internally; honest-commands rule enforced (no exact_command without validator passing); sidecar JSONL appends safely; merge_with_event_sidecar() called at both dashboard.build() and write_cache() write paths; merge preserves provider items on conflict; INBOX raw entry is NOT duplicated (append_rendered_annotation appends only the rendered block).
features.acceptance: (1) event_copy.render() produces RenderedEvent populated from translation table + plan/feature metadata. (2) Translation table keyed by NotifyEvent.inbox_event per D017; references docs/design/dashboard-value-language-ia-v0/copy-map.md vocabulary; no new vocabulary authored. (3) Honest-commands rule enforced: validate_command_tokens() passes for every non-None exact_command produced. (4) breaker:patch_incomplete renders via internal normalization to breaker_tripped + breaker_kind=patch_incomplete; INBOX event name unchanged. (5) Brand-drift translated at render boundary across all four sinks. (6) Discord sink emits rich embed with 4-band color (inline hex literals per D022, no dp-tokens.css dependency); payload-limit aware. (7) INBOX gains append_rendered_annotation() additive wrapper that appends ONLY the rendered block per D018; append_event() signature and call sites unchanged; no duplicate raw entries. (8) terminal-notifier title fixed from Jarvis [..] to DontPanic [..]. (9) Sidecar pattern wired: write_event_action_sidecar() appends to ~/.dontpanic/dashboard/event-actions.jsonl; merge_with_event_sidecar() helper called at BOTH dashboard.build() (before render_json) AND operator_console.write_cache() per D019; dashboard never auto-mutates from dispatch_event. (10) Tests cover live/dashboard_action/inbox_only/audit_only routing AND dual-merge-path coverage.

features.description: Render-boundary sanitization wiring + secret-injection assertions. Per D011 + D020, route sidecar writes through operator_console._assert_no_secret_shapes (raise mode — operator-fixable failure before persistence) and route live notification paths through a new public state_projection.scrub_secrets(s: str) -> str helper (substitute mode — live notifications must not fail-hard the supervisor). The actual existing implementation is state_projection._scrub_secrets (private name per inventory Section 5); F004 promotes it to a public scrub_secrets symbol so new code doesn't bind to a private name. No regex changes required; the existing 9-pattern matrix at sanitization_check.py:92-102 is generic over dict[str, Any] and applies unchanged. Add tests injecting plan titles containing secret-shaped substrings (sk-ant-..., ghp_..., AKIA..., discord.com/api/webhooks/..., JWT-shaped) and verifying scrubbing in every rendered channel output.
steps: Per D020, promote scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/state_projection._scrub_secrets to a public scrub_secrets(s: str) -> str symbol. Keep the private name as a backward-compat alias if any existing code imports it. New code binds to the public name only.

Wire scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/operator_console._assert_no_secret_shapes(payload_dict) at the sidecar write boundary in write_event_action_sidecar(). Raise mode: ValueError if any of the 9 regex patterns match any string in the payload tree.

Wire state_projection.scrub_secrets(string) at the live notification paths inside notify_discord.notify(), notify.notify_event(), and inbox.append_rendered_annotation(). Substitute mode: matches replaced with [REDACTED] in rendered output; the supervisor never fail-hards on a live notification with secret-shaped content.

Add tests injecting a plan title containing each of the 9 secret-shape regex matches (sk-ant-api03-XX..., ghp_XX..., AKIA..., -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----, eyJ..., xox..., discord.com/api/webhooks/..., sk-...T3BlbkFJ..., gh[osur]_XX...). Verify each is scrubbed in all four rendered surfaces.
Add a test confirming raise mode actually raises on sidecar write (operator-fixable; sidecar write rejects the rendered ActionItem rather than persisting a leaked secret).

Add a test confirming substitute mode does NOT raise on live notification paths (the supervisor must keep dispatching events even when a body contains a secret-shaped substring; the live sink renders [REDACTED] but does not crash).
features.acceptance: (1) state_projection.scrub_secrets is a public symbol per D020; private _scrub_secrets remains as a backward-compat alias if needed. (2) Sidecar write boundary calls _assert_no_secret_shapes in raise mode; secret-shaped content rejects the write. (3) Live notification paths (Discord, terminal, INBOX rendered annotation) call public scrub_secrets in substitute mode; secret-shaped content rendered as [REDACTED] without raising. (4) Test matrix covers all 9 regex patterns × 4 rendered channels (36 assertions minimum). (5) Existing sanitization_check.py tests pass unchanged (no regex modifications). (6) Sidecar fail-hard test confirms raise behavior. (7) Live-path no-fail test confirms substitute behavior.

Cross-channel parity snapshots for the six highest-value kinds: gate_hit, breaker_tripped, volley_terminal (both signed-off and non-signed-off variants), no_progress_classification, verdict_mismatch. Each kind has all four channel outputs pinned.
